title: Eclipse Prediction and the Length of the Saros in Babylonian Astronomy

passages.quote: The Saros cycle of 223 synodic months played an important role in Late Babylonian astronomy. It was used to predict the dates of future eclipse possibilities together with the times of those eclipses and underpinned the development of mathematical lunar theories.
